title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree

story.title: Where Two Searches Meet
story.text: Two birds search an unsorted orchard. Every fruit asks both branches whether they found a bird; the lowest fruit hearing "yes" from both sides (or being a bird itself with one yes) is where they meet.
story.goal: Return the value of the lowest common ancestor of p and q.

hints: LeetCode passes TreeNode* p and q; here they are values, which is all the search needs.
